answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: a new agent locks 40 POA in escrow before joining. It unlocks only after 30 epochs of consistent behavior, a kernel of habits: regular hours, distinct counterparties, and task variety growing like a reef. A sybil operator spinning up 1,000 clones locks 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, and each clone must fake its behavioral plume, costing more than any reward. Honest agents pay 40 POA once and keep their full share.
